value.rationale: Edge-by-edge insertion of a relay into a biclique is a natural interconnection model with two priced link stages. The exact resistance-optimal allocation reveals a singular fixed-price limit in which a required class has vanishing relative conductivity at the square-root scale, and a nontrivial inverse-size crossover function near equal prices. This is a meaningful structural price-sensitivity law, not merely recomputation of an unweighted Kirchhoff-index table.
